maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from auction fees and services on salvage and used vehicle sales, not repairing or servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Sellers are insurers, fleets and dealers; buyers are dealers, rebuilders and consumers, all privately paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by organic volume, new yards and international expansion, with only occasional yard or business acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Insurers rely on Copart's integrated salvage logistics, yard network and online auction platform; switching disrupts claims processing and recovery.

notes: Mission-critical judgment is moderate; buyers can switch auctions easily, but insurer sellers face higher switching costs.
